transfers.name: transfers
transfers.default: '[{"id":"person","name":"Owner","number":null,"condition":"The caller asks to speak to a person","hours_only":true,"ring_seconds":25,"if_no_answer":"message","enabled":true}]'::jsonb

availability_exceptions_times.name: availability_exceptions_times
availability_exceptions_times.value: ("availability_exceptions"."start_time" is null and "availability_exceptions"."end_time" is null) or coalesce("availability_exceptions"."end_time" > "availability_exceptions"."start_time", false)

billing_recharges_amount.name: billing_recharges_amount
billing_recharges_amount.value: "billing_recharges"."amount_cents" between (case when "billing_recharges"."manual" then 500 else 2000 end) and 50000

ledger_entries_kind_source.name: ledger_entries_kind_source
ledger_entries_kind_source.value: ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'usage' and "ledger_entries"."source_type" = 'call') or ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'number' and "ledger_entries"."source_type" = 'phone_number') or ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'recharge' and "ledger_entries"."source_type" = 'billing_recharge') or ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'topup' and "ledger_entries"."source_type" = 'stripe_checkout') or ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'refund' and "ledger_entries"."source_type" = 'stripe_refund') or ("ledger_entries"."kind" in ('credit', 'adjustment', 'writeoff') and "ledger_entries"."source_type" in ('admin', 'job'))

ledger_entries_usage_seconds.name: ledger_entries_usage_seconds
ledger_entries_usage_seconds.value: "ledger_entries"."kind" <> 'usage' or ("ledger_entries"."seconds" is not null and "ledger_entries"."included_seconds" is not null and "ledger_entries"."billable_seconds" is not null and "ledger_entries"."included_seconds" >= 0 and "ledger_entries"."billable_seconds" >= 0 and "ledger_entries"."seconds" = "ledger_entries"."included_seconds" + "ledger_entries"."billable_seconds")

ledger_entries_seconds_usage_only.name: ledger_entries_seconds_usage_only
ledger_entries_seconds_usage_only.value: "ledger_entries"."kind" = 'usage' or ("ledger_entries"."seconds" is null and "ledger_entries"."included_seconds" is null and "ledger_entries"."billable_seconds" is null)

ledger_entries_sign.name: ledger_entries_sign
ledger_entries_sign.value: ("ledger_entries"."kind" in ('usage', 'number', 'refund') and "ledger_entries"."amount_micros" <= 0) or ("ledger_entries"."kind" in ('recharge', 'topup', 'credit', 'writeoff') and "ledger_entries"."amount_micros" >= 0) or "ledger_entries"."kind" = 'adjustment'

partner_branding_approved.name: partner_branding_approved
partner_branding_approved.value: ("partner_branding"."approved_revision" is null) = ("partner_branding"."approved_name" is null) and ("partner_branding"."approved_revision" is null) = ("partner_branding"."approved_at" is null)
